name: llxterm
description: A window of real browser pages, terminals and a kanban board that Claude works in and you watch, with a line for its tabs, its cards and your comments

finish_cards.title: Hold Claude to its board card
finish_cards.description: When Claude stops while its own card is still in Doing on the board, ask it once to hand the card in, release it or block it first. Subagents are always held to their cards.
